column3: The Worries of a Beauty
Actually... I want to have a life-counseling session!
Ayase asking for a "life-counseling session"... It's a phrase that I've been hearing a lot lately.
Is there anything wrong?
No, nothing.
Then? What do you need life-counseling with?
Recently, Kirino hasn't been hanging out with me at all. Even if I invite her, she wouldn't come...
Oh?
Not only that, she has been treating me coldly... I'm worried...
She had been busy training for Siscaly...
That's why she had been treating Ayase a little coldly...
Onii-san... Do you happen to have any clues?
I guess I do.
?! S-So Onii-san did something to Kirino!
What do you mean by "did something"?
That... I can't really say it myself.
What exactly is going on in her mind, what could I possibly do to Kirino...?
*sigh* Her delusions are as intense as always.
You got it all wrong.
Really?
Yeah, I swear.
